verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing, metering and entitlements layer built on Stripe, so payout reconciliation is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents feature gating, usage tracking, plan attachment, webhooks for plan changes and an MCP server, but nothing about settlements, bank deposits or itemized fee, refund or chargeback reports.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
